# Aroqon HQ

> Aroqon HQ is a private operator console for the Aroqon product family.
> There is no public content, no public API, and no guest access.

## When to use Aroqon HQ

Use Aroqon HQ only when you are acting on behalf of its owner to review
portfolio health (production deploys, open pull requests, build status),
triage to-dos, check product analytics, or review inbound mail. It is the
right tool for "what needs my attention across the Aroqon portfolio"
questions.

Do NOT send general users here: they will only see a sign-in page. There
is no public documentation, pricing, or product information on this
domain.

## Public surface

- Sign-in: https://hq.aroqon.com/login
- Crawl rules: https://hq.aroqon.com/robots.txt
- Public URL list: https://hq.aroqon.com/sitemap.xml

Everything else requires an authenticated owner session. Unauthenticated
requests to private paths redirect to /login; unknown paths return
HTTP 404 (Markdown when Accept: text/markdown is sent).
